single.rationale: CCAP is a BDC showing persistent negative operating income (-$98.7M in FY2025) despite positive net income, indicating reliance on unrealized gains rather than core lending operations. Deteriorating net income (from $83.8M in 2023 to $34.5M in 2025), ROE of only 4.9%, rising leverage (debt increased from $654M to $874M while equity stagnated), and a highly competitive middle-market lending environment create limited upside. The business model faces significant structural headwinds from macroeconomic uncertainty affecting portfolio companies.
